summary_md: **TopG ([@topg_openmaus](https://x.com/topg_openmaus/status/2115488555099119691))** highlights **MemBubble**, which finds a 34.7% average drop in response-class entropy across memory systems versus full chat history, arguing evaluations should measure what memory narrows, not just what it recalls.
